var i = $('joy/not_self').first().json

i.id = $input.first().json.smart_id
i.is_categorized = $input.first().json.is_categorized
i.operation_key = $input.first().json.operation_key

return { ...$input.first().json, ...i  };

var i = $('joy/parser').first().json

i.is_categorized = true
i.operation_key = $input.first().json.operation.key
i.operation_id = $input.first().json.operation.id

return [i];

var i = $('joy/output').first().json
var lead_data = { 
  "target_id": $('update lead').first().json.target_id, 
  "content_id": $('update lead').first().json.content_id,
  "source_id": $('update lead').first().json.source_id,
  "session_uuid": $('update lead').first().json.session_uuid,
  "source_type": $('update lead').first().json.source_type,
  "source_endpoint": $('update lead').first().json.source_endpoint,
  "delay": Math.round(Math.random()*2) + 1,
  "current_stage": $('update lead').first().json.current_stage,
  "discovery_level": $('update lead').first().json.discovery_level,
  "enchantment_level":  $('update lead').first().json.enchantment_level,
  "name": $('update lead').first().json.name,
  "email": $('update lead').first().json.email,
  "phone": $('update lead').first().json.phone,
  "ig_username": $('update lead').first().json.ig_username
}

return i.messages.filter(function(p) { return p.sender_role == 'agent' }).map(function(p) { return { ...p, ...lead_data } }).sort(function(a,b) { return a.id >= b.id; });
